name: io.github.sepehr071/iran-crypto-mcp
title: Iran Crypto Exchanges
description: Unofficial read-only Iranian crypto exchanges: prices in Toman, order books, trades, candles.

environmentVariables.name: IRAN_CRYPTO_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for exchange requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
